intro: At Petromac we design and manufacture a broad range of bespoke devices for the wireline logging industry. Petromac devices provide a quantum improvement in risk control for both the wireline logging companies and the operators we serve to deliver significant cost and time saving benefits.

quote.text: Petromac started with the sole aim of improving wireline logging efficiency and enhancing log data quality for Operators, particularly in challenging wellbore conditions. Our dedicated regional managers have a wealth of wireline logging experience, and continually strive to push the boundaries through innovation and expertise.

pillars.title: Operational Efficiency
pillars.text: Ultra-low friction wheels reduce whole-tool drag to enable gravity descents to 80° deviation — conventional wireline operations in wellbores usually logged by pipe-conveyed logging, tractors or LWD.

pillars.title: Sticking Prevention
pillars.text: Carrying logging tools on wheeled carriages cuts contact area with the borehole wall by ~99% and lets tools roll out of differential-sticking scenarios.

pillars.title: Well Access
pillars.text: Orientation-positioned holefinders navigate ledges and washouts without losing momentum, with a far higher success rate than traditional holefinders.

pillars.title: Sensor Orientation
pillars.text: Orienting the logging tool sensors enables low-side pad contact, high-side fluid sampling, X-Y density, oriented side-wall coring and valid density down-logs.

pillars.title: Centralization
pillars.text: Focus™ centralisers achieve near-perfect centralization while minimizing drag — better log quality and deeper reach in deviated wells.

productLines.name: Wireline Express™
productLines.text: A diverse range of Taxis and Guides for wireline logging tools which provide conveyance, orientation and well access solutions to deliver improved operational efficiency and data quality.

productLines.name: Focus™ Precision Centralisers
productLines.text: Evolved from Wireline Express™: a ground-up analysis of centraliser mechanics and logging applications led to devices that achieve near perfect centralisation and enable gravity descent, regardless of deviation.

about.patents: Petromac devices are protected by one or more patents in the US and elsewhere.

categories.name: Tool Taxis
categories.tagline: The Wireline Express™ Tool Taxi system — wheeled carriages that carry logging tools for orientation, conveyance, centering and formation testing.
intro: Tool Taxis carry the logging string on ultra-low-friction wheels. Two bearing families cover every application: Type A taxis use tungsten carbide bush bearings (gravity logging to 70° deviation), while Type B taxis run on sealed, pressure-compensated ball bearings in a lubricant bath — the lowest friction in class, for gravity logging to 80° deviation.

categories.name: Guides & Holefinders
categories.tagline: Hole finders and guides that navigate ledges, washouts and restrictions — the universal Pathfinder plus fixed angle guides for SLB, Halliburton and Baker Hughes tools.
intro: Petromac offers a range of holefinders to fit various logging tools. These guides enable passing through washouts and ledges seamlessly and without losing momentum.

categories.name: Focus™ Centralisers
categories.tagline: Precision roller centralisers for open and cased hole — perfect centralization with minimal drag.
intro: The Focus™ range was developed with two objectives: achieve perfect centralization, and minimize the drag associated with achieving it — giving operators the perfect log.

categories.name: Well Intervention Accessories
categories.tagline: Rollers and weight-bar taxis for cased hole conveyance and production logging.

products.name: Orienting Taxis TTA-505 & TTB-505
products.summary: Slip-over orienting taxis with 0.5” standoff in an 8.5” wellbore — tungsten carbide (TTA) or sealed ball bearing (TTB).

variants.title: TTA-505 — Type A, Tungsten Carbide Bearing
description: Slip-over tool taxis with tungsten carbide bush bearings, designed to orient & reduce the drag coefficient of a logging tool string.
Taxis lock securely onto the tool housings or into c-spanner recess holes and fit both 3 5/8” and 3 3/8” logging tool housings.
applications: Gravity logging up to 70 degrees well deviation using a slip-over wheel design
Orient logging tool sensors, cores, pressure measurements and samples without the need for standoffs, bow springs, tool turners etc.
Eliminate risk of tool differential sticking by offsetting tools from the wellbore wall
Robust design. Very low maintenance requirement.

variants.title: TTB-505 — Type B, Ball Bearing
description: Slip-over tool taxis designed to orient & reduce the drag coefficient of a logging tool string.
Taxi wheels run on ball bearings in a sealed, pressure compensated, lubricant bath providing the lowest friction in class.
Taxis lock securely onto the housings or into c-spanner recess holes and fit a range of logging tool housing OD.
applications: Gravity logging up to 80 degrees well deviation using a slip-over wheel design
Orient logging tool sensors, cores, and pressure measurements and samples without the need for standoffs, bow springs, tool turners etc.
Eliminate risk of tool differential sticking by offsetting tools from the borehole
Robust design. Very low maintenance requirement.
